devdoc.details: Stores and manages all campaign data. Does NOT hold ETH.      Only the StartupFund contract (set as authorized) can write state.

checkStatus(uint256).details: Evaluates and updates the campaign status.      - Goal reached → FUNDED      - Deadline passed + goal not met → CANCELLED

createCampaign((string,string,string,str.details: Creates a new campaign. Called by StartupFund.createCampaign().

flagCampaign(uint256).details: Marks a campaign as FLAGGED by community vote. Called by StartupFund.flagCampaign().

setAuthorized(address).details: Called once after StartupFund is deployed.

updateCampaign(uint256,string,string,str.details: Updates editable campaign fields. Only allowed before any contributor funds.      Called by StartupFund.updateCampaign().

updateRaisedAmount(uint256,uint256,bool).details: Updates the raised amount and backer count. Called by StartupFund.fundCampaign().
